concerns.text: The PR includes compiled, minified, and fingerprinted frontend build artifacts (index-CU1kXetK.js, index-CYdzpQUL.css) in the 'src/main/resources/static/assets/' directory. While committing static builds might sometimes be required for certain hosting or local-run configurations, doing so usually increases the risk of merge conflicts and bloats the git repository. It is highly recommended to build these assets during the CI/CD pipeline rather than checking them in.

In 'KnowledgeBase.svelte', the Svelte 5 reactive effect ($effect) triggers a new search/list fetch API request immediately on every keystroke within the 'searchQuery' state. Without any debouncing logic, this could result in an excessive number of database queries and server-side workload. Adding a small debounce (e.g., 200-300ms) is recommended.

In 'KnowledgeBase.svelte', the 'getDocumentSize' function computes file sizes deterministically using a mock character-code sum/hash algorithm. While this is sufficient for a UI slice, if real document sizes are available in the backend response, they should be used instead of a client-side mock.
